# Emerald Publishing

> > Emerald Publishing is an academic publishing platform providing research submission, review, and publication services for scholarly journals and books.

Emerald Publishing operates a comprehensive submission and manuscript management system called Chronos, supporting researchers, authors, and reviewers in the academic publishing workflow. The platform requires modern browsers including Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Microsoft Edge, Apple Safari, or Opera for optimal functionality.

## Key Topics

- Emerald Publishing
- Academic Publishing
- Chronos Submission Platform
- Manuscript Submission
- User Authentication
- Author Registration
- Scholarly Journals
- Research Publication
- Peer Review
- Account Management
- Browser Compatibility
- Access Control

## Submission Platform

- [Emerald Publishing Submit](https://submit.emerald.com/?return=/dashboard/&state=disabled): Submission platform login and registration portal for authors, reviewers, and editors to access the Chronos manuscript management system
